zh.title: 先准备电脑，再拿起手机。
zh.intro: 第一次需要在两台设备上各装一个应用。我们一步步来，让今天的照片，在家里多一份备份。
zh.desktopTitle: 你家里用的是哪种电脑？
zh.desktopText: 电脑负责保存照片。这一步请在电脑上操作，并预留足够的硬盘空间。
zh.copied: 已复制。回到电脑的命令窗口，粘贴并按回车。
zh.copyFailed: 请选中上方完整命令，手动复制。
zh.help: 遇到问题？查看详细帮助

platforms.name: Windows
platforms.openText: 在电脑的“开始”菜单搜索 PowerShell，然后打开。不需要选择“以管理员身份运行”。
platforms.pasteTitle: 复制下面这条命令，粘贴后按回车
platforms.finishTitle: 等待安装，然后完成照片存储设置
platforms.finishText: 安装会下载所需文件并启动 Lomorage。跟着电脑上打开的设置页面完成首次设置；以后可以从“开始”菜单搜索 Lomorage 打开。
platforms.detailNote: 适用于 Windows x64 电脑。安装期间需要联网；不必反复粘贴命令。

platforms.name: macOS
platforms.openText: 按 Command + 空格，搜索“终端”并打开。不需要输入管理员密码。
platforms.pasteTitle: 复制下面这条命令，粘贴后按回车
platforms.finishTitle: 等待安装，然后完成照片存储设置
platforms.finishText: 安装会自动匹配 Apple 芯片或 Intel 电脑，并启动 Lomorage。按打开的设置页面完成首次设置；以后可以搜索 Lomorage 或从菜单栏打开。
platforms.detailNote: 安装需要 Python 3。如果提示缺少 python3，可按下方详细帮助准备所需组件后重试。

zh.phoneTitle: 接着，在手机上装好应用。
zh.phoneText: 用手机点击对应按钮，或用手机相机扫描二维码。电脑端安装完成后，保持它开着。
zh.phoneBack: 电脑还没准备好？先看电脑安装步骤
zh.connectTitle: 先试着备份几张，看看它们的新家。

connectSteps.title: 让手机和电脑连到同一个家庭网络
connectSteps.text: 确认电脑上的 Lomorage 已打开，并完成首次设置。

connectSteps.title: 在手机应用里连接家里的电脑
connectSteps.text: 按提示添加或选择电脑，创建账号或登录。每位家人可以使用自己的账号。

connectSteps.title: 开始备份，再打开照片看一看
connectSteps.text: 先用少量照片熟悉流程。确认备份完成、照片能打开，再逐步备份整个相册。

zh.connectionQuestion: 手机里没有找到电脑，怎么办？
zh.connectionAnswer: 当前快捷安装默认关闭自动发现。可在手机应用中手动填写电脑的局域网 IP 地址与端口（默认 8000）。确认两台设备在同一网络，且电脑防火墙允许家庭网络访问。手机中不要填写 localhost，它代表手机本身。
zh.connectionHelp: 需要帮忙连接？联系我们
zh.optionalTitle: 已经有很多老照片，或使用其他设备？
zh.optionalNote: 第一次备份手机照片，可以先跳过这里。
zh.importTitle: 把旧硬盘里的照片也整理进来
zh.importText: 电脑端和手机账号准备好后，下载导入工具。解压打开，使用已有账号登录，选择照片文件夹，再开始导入。
zh.importHelp: 查看文件夹与 USB 导入说明
zh.otherTitle: 使用 NAS、树莓派或 Linux？
zh.otherText: 这些设备也有对应的安装方式，可以按自己的设备查阅文档。
zh.otherLink: 查看其他设备安装说明
zh.supportLink: 告诉我们你使用的电脑和手机

en.title: Your computer first. Your phone next.
en.intro: For your first backup, install an app on each device. Let’s take it one step at a time and give today’s photos another home.
en.desktopTitle: Which computer do you use at home?
en.desktopText: Your computer stores the photos. Complete this step on that computer, with enough free disk space for your collection.
en.copied: Copied. Paste into the command window on your computer and press Enter.
en.copyFailed: Select the full command above and copy it manually.
en.help: Having trouble? Read the detailed guide

platforms.name: Windows
platforms.openText: Search for PowerShell in your computer’s Start menu and open it. You do not need to choose “Run as administrator”.
platforms.pasteTitle: Copy the command, paste it, and press Enter
platforms.finishTitle: Let it install, then set up your photo storage
platforms.finishText: The installer downloads the files and starts Lomorage. Follow the setup page that opens on your computer. Later, search for Lomorage in the Start menu to reopen it.
platforms.detailNote: For Windows x64 computers. Stay connected to the internet during installation; there is no need to paste the command again.

platforms.name: macOS
platforms.openText: Press Command + Space, search for Terminal, and open it. You do not need an administrator password.
platforms.pasteTitle: Copy the command, paste it, and press Enter
platforms.finishTitle: Let it install, then set up your photo storage
platforms.finishText: The installer selects the Apple silicon or Intel build and starts Lomorage. Follow the setup page that opens. Later, search for Lomorage or open it from the menu bar.
platforms.detailNote: Python 3 is required. If the installer reports that python3 is missing, use the detailed guide below to prepare the required tools before retrying.

en.phoneTitle: Next, get the app on your phone.
en.phoneText: Tap the button on your phone, or scan a code with its camera. Keep Lomorage running on your computer once setup is complete.
en.phoneBack: Computer not ready yet? Start with its setup steps
en.iosButton: Get it on the App Store
en.iosNote: Look for LomoMobile in the store
en.connectTitle: Try a few photos. See their new home.

connectSteps.title: Connect both devices to your home network
connectSteps.text: Make sure Lomorage is running on your computer and its first-time setup is complete.

connectSteps.title: Connect to your computer in the phone app
connectSteps.text: Add or select your computer, then create an account or sign in. Each family member can use a separate account.

connectSteps.title: Back up, then open your photos
connectSteps.text: Start with a small batch. Check that backup is complete and the photos open before moving on to your whole collection.

en.connectionQuestion: My phone can’t find my computer. What next?
en.connectionAnswer: The current quick installer disables automatic discovery by default. Enter your computer’s local network IP address and port (8000 by default) in the phone app. Both devices must be on the same network, and the computer’s firewall must allow access from your home network. Do not enter localhost on your phone; that refers to the phone itself.
en.optionalTitle: Have older photos, or a different device?
en.optionalNote: You can skip this for your first phone backup.
en.importTitle: Bring photos from an existing hard drive
en.importText: Once your computer and phone account are set up, download the importer. Extract and open it, sign in with your existing account, select a photo folder, and start importing.
en.importHelp: Read the folder & USB import guide
en.otherTitle: Using a NAS, Raspberry Pi, or Linux?
en.otherText: There are installation options for these devices too. Follow the guide for the device you already have.
en.supportNote: Not sure what to do next?
en.supportLink: Tell us which computer and phone you use
